//: `dynamic-config` on npm is an unrelated package by another author. This distribution takes the qualified name, exactly as `dynamic-config-py` does on PyPI, and the import is the package name.
name: dynamic-config-node
description: Hot-reloadable configuration for Node.js: Rust resolves, your schema validates
author: Cevat Batuhan Tolon <cevatbatuhan.tolon@gmail.com>

scripts.build: cargo build -p dynamic-config-node --release && node -e "const {copyFileSync, existsSync} = require('fs'); const built = ['../target/release/libdynamic_config_node.so', '../target/release/libdynamic_config_node.dylib', '../target/release/dynamic_config_node.dll'].find(existsSync); copyFileSync(built, 'index.node')"
